- On-prem package: install modes, HSM/KMS options, and cert rotation (15m)

Grace / Soojin — forwarding NimbusPay's diagram and the ask. Quick split of responsibilities for the Jul 10 kickoff: 

- Grace O'Connor: lead network design + acceptance criteria (CIDR plan, peering tests, firewall rules). Follow up with firewall vendor compatibility check.
- Soojin Lee: private endpoints, on-prem package install modes, and cert/KMS flow. Draft a short runbook for credential bootstrap with both cloud KMS and HSM options.
- Marcus: run kickoff, own the overall timeline and liaise with Nimbus PM.

Pre-kickoff deliverables (due Jul 8 COB):
1) Grace: proposed CIDR allocations + list of required firewall rules (one-pager)
2) Soojin: one-page cert/KMS comparison and a 10-step install checklist we can use in staging
3) Marcus: final agenda + meeting invite

I'll create JIRA ticket NIM-4821 to track the work. Please drop any concerns here — if the CIDRs overlap with Nimbus internal plans, we can widen the ranges; avoid 10.0.0.0/8 family to reduce collisions.

Looking forward to the call. I'll invite the Nimbus PM and their security lead so we can triage the KMS questions live.
